bullets: Define two classes: class I and Class II
let d(X) be a discriminant function = W^T X
if X ∈ class I then d(X) > 0
if X ∈ class II then d(X) < 0
If X ∈ class I and misclassified as Class II then d(X) will be <0
If X ∈ class II and misclassified as Class I then d(X) will be >0
Error = Σ all misclassified vectors (i) W^T X_i ⇒ (W^T X_i) take positive and negative values X
If X ∈ class I and misclassified as Class II then d(X) will be <0 ⇒ δ_i = -1 ⇒ d(X) δ_i >0
If X ∈ class II and misclassified as Class I then d(X) will be >0 ⇒ δ_i = +1 ⇒ d(X) δ_i >0
equations: (W^T X_i) take positive and negative values

recreation_brief:
1. Create a new PowerPoint slide with light gray background (#f0f0f0).
2. Add title 'Problem Formulation' centered at top in bold red (#c00000) sans-serif font, approx 32-36pt.
3. Add slide number '3' in a circle at top-right corner.
4. Insert four vertically stacked rectangular text boxes with red borders (#c00000), white fill, spanning most of slide width.
5. In Box 1, type: 'Define two classes: class I and Class II' (color 'class I' red, 'Class II' green), then 'let d(X) be a discriminant function = W^T X' (color final X green), then 'if X ∈ class I then d(X) > 0' (color '> 0' red), then 'if X ∈ class II then d(X) < 0' (color '< 0' blue).
6. In Box 2, type: 'For misclassified X :' (color X red), then 'If X ∈ class I and misclassified as Class II then d(X) will be <0' (color '<0' red), then 'If X ∈ class II and misclassified as Class I then d(X) will be >0' (color '>0' blue).
7. In Box 3, type: 'Define Error function as:', then equation 'Error = Σ' with subscript 'all misclassified vectors (i)', then 'W^T X_i', then '⇒', then '(W^T X_i) take positive and negative values', then large red 'X' at end.
8. In Box 4, type: 'Define δ_i as :', then line 1: 'If X ∈ class I and misclassified as Class II then d(X) will be <0 ⇒ δ_i = -1 ⇒ d(X) δ_i >0' (color '<0' red), then line 2: 'If X ∈ class II and misclassified as Class I then d(X) will be >0 ⇒ δ_i = +1 ⇒ d(X) δ_i >0' (color '>0' blue).
9. Use sans-serif font (e.g., Calibri or Arial) for all text; body approx 18-20pt; ensure subscripts and superscripts are formatted correctly.
